label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_01
text: Ready to go photograph some Pokémon and\nsurvey the forest for me?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_01
text: Reporting for survey duty!

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_02
text: Maybe another time...

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_02
text: Then let’s hang in the tent until the weather gets\nnice and foggy.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_03
text: Looks like this is about as good as it’s gonna get.\nAll right, partner! Get out there and survey![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_poke_01
text: Took a new photo? Lemme see...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_01
text: That’s the Imitation Pokémon, Sudowoodo! It’s\nreal easy to mistake it for a tree in this fog.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_02
text: The Candle Pokémon, Litwick! Seeing those little\nlights floating in the dark is otherworldly, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_03
text: The Calm Pokémon, Hatenna, huh? Must feel\nright at home in a quiet forest like this.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_04
text: It’s the Rock Pokémon, Geodude! You’ve gotta\nbe careful, or you might trip over this fella![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_05
text: That’s the Toxic Lizard Pokémon, Salandit, right?\nSneaking up on some prey in the dark, maybe?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_06
text: The Stag Beetle Pokémon, Vikavolt! Those huge\njaws it has make for a real killer photo![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_07
text: The Firefly Pokémon, Illumise! Word has it that it\ngets along real well with Volbeat.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_08
text: That’s the Acorn Pokémon, Seedot...right?! Pretty\neasy to mistake it for a Berry or something![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_09
text: That’s the String Spit Pokémon, Spinarak! Do you\nthink it’s trying to spin up a new web in the trees?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_10
text: The Cheeky Pokémon, Skwovet! What would you\nbet it’s looking for food from up in the trees?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_11
text: The Water Weed Pokémon, Lotad! Now that’s\nthe good life, just floating around like that...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_12
text: The EleFish Pokémon, Tynamo! You’ve got a real\nknack for this, spotting something so tiny![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_13
text: The Firefly Pokémon, Volbeat, huh? I heard it can\ndraw shapes using the light on its rear end![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_14
text: The Requiem Pokémon, Duskull... It makes quite\nthe impression on a dark night like this![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_15
text: The Owl Pokémon, Hoothoot! I’ve always wanted\nto get a shot of it switching the foot it stands on.[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_16
text: You got both the Firefly Pokémon, Volbeat and\nIllumise! They look so good together. Great shot![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_17
text: The Firefly Pokémon, Illumise! I bet that Volbeat\nshowed up just to be with it, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeget_18
text: The Firefly Pokémon, Volbeat! I bet that Illumise\nshowed up just to be with it, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_01
text: This is great! I knew you were the right person\nfor the job![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_02
text: You really do take great photos, partner!\c\nHave you tried turning your eyes upward, too?\nThere may be Pokémon lurking up in the trees...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_03
text: You have a real eye for photography, partner!\c\nI bet you could even get great shots of Pokémon\nthat refuse to sit still and always wander around![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_04
text: That’s my partner for you!\c\nYou know, I bet there could be Pokémon in caves\nnearby too. You could probably snap some shots![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_05
text:
You’ve got a real knack for this sort of thing!\c
I bet getting those Pokémon that hang near the
water in the northwest part of the forest would
be a walk in the park for someone like you![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_06
text:
Nice... You’ve done some real fine work here!\c
Oh, one tip from me? Watch your footing when
you get to that area with all the rocks—I tripped
and nearly faceplanted in the dark![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_07
text:
So it looks like you’ve got a real good handle on
how to take photos by now, huh?\c
I bet you even know that some Pokémon are so
wary they’ll run if you get too close! You’ve gotta
be careful if you wanna catch them on film![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_08
text:
You are getting all kinds of different Pokémon
in your photos!\c
It can be tricky—like with Ghost-type Pokémon!
Snapping a photo of one before it disappears
requires a quick shutter finger![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_09
text:
Mm-hmm! You’re getting real practiced at
catching Pokémon out and about their daily lives.\c
I’d guess you could even catch Pokémon up in
the trees searching for their next meal![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_10
text:
Just what I’ve come to expect of my partner!
Your photos really showcase your good taste!\c
Oh, and did you hear that sound coming from the
northeast? Like thunder or something? I wonder
if it could be Electric-type Pokémon...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_11
text:
The composition! The motifs! I think your skills
are wasted here in the backwater, helping me.\c
Oh, but before you abandon me...have you
been up around the water in the northwest?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokehint_12
text: I bet there are still some more Pokémon hiding in\nthe forest you haven’t photographed yet...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_poke_02
text: Well, keep up the good work! I’ve got nothing\nbut high hopes for you, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_poke_03
text: Just one more Pokémon and your survey work\nwill be complete! Keep it up, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_01
text: Huh...? Wait, this picture doesn’t contain a single\nPokémon, does it?![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_02
text: Ummm... Yeah, I’m not sure the machine will be\nable to process this without a clearer shot...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_03
text: Nothing new to see here! Try looking for\nPokémon you haven’t photographed yet![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_04
text: Hmm... Yeah, I don’t think the machine can get\nmuch from images so small. Can’t you get closer?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokemiss_05
text:
Hmm... Looks like the machine can’t use your
photo data.\c
I guess it’s too hard to get a clear reading when
a Pokémon is in the process of running away?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_pokeclear_01
text: And with that, you’ve completed your survey!\nWell done, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_stop_01
text: Do you want to end your survey early?

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_03
text: End it now

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_select_04
text: Keep going

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_stop_02
text: Okay, let’s call it! We’re all done for tonight!

text: [EMPTY 62]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ride_01
text: Probably best not to ride on [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0202)]KoMiraidon if the aim\nis to sneak up on Pokémon...

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ui_01_01
text: Get Those Photos!

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ui_01_02
text: Open Camera

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_ui_01_03
text: End Survey

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_talk_01
text: How’s the survey coming along, partner?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_01
text: Huh? What’s this? You got a shot of me?[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_02
text: Heh heh! Did you get a good shot? Hope I didn’t\nlook too stiff or anything![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_03
text: Wow, I’m not used to being on the other side of\na lens. It’s kind of awkward...[VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_04
text: Gah! Stop, stop, stop! Now I’m all self-conscious\nand can’t look natural! It’s embarrassing![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_sazare_camera_05
text: ...OK, for real—I’m not your subject! Take photos\nof Pokémon already, would you![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_camera_01
text: It’s hard to get a good shot crouched down low...

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_growlithe_camera_01
text: Wa-wow!

label: s1_side02_fieldwork_growlithe_camera_02
text: Aw, you took Growlithe for me? You sweetie!\c\nI mean, sure, it’s no help at all for the survey,\nbut I still love to see his photos![VAR 0x0114(0046)]
